headline: As of 2026-11-07: 74,838,360 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 48 of 50 states, D+4.3 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 74,838,360 early/mail ballots cast so far across 48 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+4.3 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (10,677,324), Florida (8,332,352), Texas (8,173,864).
